title: Pokemon TCG Zekrom Paradox Rift 066/182 Reverse Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Pokémon card features the powerful Zekrom in stunning Reverse Holo finish. With a Card Size of Standard and a Card Number of 066/182, this card is a must-have for any serious collector of the Pokémon Trading Card Game. The card is part of the Scarlet & Violet - Paradox Rift set and is in English language.

Perfect for fans of the game and collectors alike, this card is a valuable addition to any collection. Don't miss out on the chance to own this amazing card!
